category_one_liner: CRM and sales automation platform for managing deals, contacts, pipelines, and activities.
api_surface: Comprehensive REST API covering deals, persons, organizations, activities, pipelines, products, notes, webhooks, and more.
mcp_evidence: Pipedrive Marketplace (https://marketplace.pipedrive.com) lists third‑party integrations built on its API.

category_one_liner: Customer messaging platform for support, sales, and onboarding
api_surface: Comprehensive REST API covering Users, Contacts, Leads, Companies, Conversations, Messages, Tags, Events, and Webhooks
mcp_evidence: Intercom offers an App Store for partner integrations but does not publicly reference a Managed Connectors Program (MCP)

category_one_liner: Slack is a team communication and messaging platform offering real-time chat, channels, and integrations.
api_surface: Comprehensive REST and WebSocket (RTM) APIs covering messages, channels, users, files, reactions, shortcuts, events, dialogs, modals, and admin functions.
mcp_evidence: Slack provides an App Directory and developer portal, but no publicly documented Managed Cloud Platform (MCP) specific to third‑party integration.

category_one_liner: Telegram is a cloud‑based messaging and communications platform offering chat, voice, video, and bot interactions.
api_surface: Telegram Bot API provides endpoints for sending messages, media, managing chats, inline queries, payments, and webhook integration.
mcp_evidence: No publicly documented Managed Cloud Platform (MCP) specific to Telegram; integration is via the Bot API.

category_one_liner: All‑in‑one marketing and sales platform for agencies, offering funnels, CRM, email, SMS, and ad management.
api_surface: REST API covering contacts, pipelines, opportunities, campaigns, triggers, appointments, forms, surveys, and integrations with ads, email, and social tools.
mcp_evidence: No public reference to a Managed Connector Platform (MCP) in GoHighLevel documentation or developer portal.

category_one_liner: Shopify is a leading ecommerce platform that lets merchants create and manage online stores via a rich set of APIs.
gating_reason: Certain sensitive scopes (e.g., orders, payments) and some partner APIs require app review and approval before production use.
api_surface: Comprehensive REST and GraphQL Admin APIs covering products, collections, orders, customers, inventory, fulfillment, discounts, payments, and more, plus Storefront, Checkout, and Billing APIs.
mcp_evidence: Shopify provides a Merchant (Shop) Admin dashboard where store owners manage settings, apps, and data; this serves as the Merchant Control Panel.
main_blocker: None for basic functionality; only apps needing privileged scopes must pass Shopify's review process.

category_one_liner: Web crawling and content extraction API for SEO and data scraping.
api_surface: RESTful HTTP endpoints for crawling URLs, extracting page content, generating sitemaps, and batch crawling, returning JSON responses.
mcp_evidence: No public listing on AWS Marketplace, GCP Marketplace, or Azure Marketplace as of 2026.

category_one_liner: Deploy, manage, and automate sites, functions, and related services on Netlify via a RESTful API.
api_surface: Comprehensive REST API covering sites, builds, deploys, functions, plugins, DNS, forms, team settings, and more.
mcp_evidence: Netlify provides a platform-as-a-service but does not expose a separate Managed Cloud Platform product; its API is directly for the Netlify service.

category_one_liner: The Notion API provides programmatic access to Notion workspaces, enabling creation, retrieval, and manipulation of pages, databases, blocks, and users.
api_surface: RESTful JSON API with endpoints for pages, databases, blocks, users, and search.
mcp_evidence: Notion does not maintain a public integration marketplace; integrations are listed on their website but there is no dedicated marketplace platform.

category_one_liner: Payments and financial infrastructure platform for online businesses
api_surface: Comprehensive RESTful API covering payments, billing, subscriptions, invoicing, payouts, fraud detection, and Connect platform capabilities
mcp_evidence: Stripe Connect provides a managed platform for marketplaces and platforms to onboard sellers via OAuth and handle payouts

category_one_liner: Financial data and market intelligence platform offering company, investor, deal, and fund information.
gating_reason: Access requires an approved enterprise subscription and manual provisioning of API credentials by PitchBook sales/account teams.
api_surface: Endpoints for searching and retrieving company profiles, investor details, deal histories, fund data, and market analytics, with bulk export capabilities.
mcp_evidence: Public documentation does not mention a dedicated Managed Cloud Platform; the API is offered directly to subscribed customers.
main_blocker: Need for a paid PitchBook subscription and manual approval to obtain API credentials.

category_one_liner: AI-powered transcription and note‑taking platform for meetings, interviews, and lectures.
gating_reason: API access appears limited to enterprise/partner accounts and requires a request or invitation.
api_surface: Upload audio, start live transcription, retrieve transcripts, speaker diarization, search within transcripts, export formats (txt, srt, pdf).
mcp_evidence: The help site is hosted at help.otter.ai and references an MCP (Managed Cloud Platform) for integration.
main_blocker: No publicly documented, self‑serve API endpoints or authentication flow; access is restricted to approved partners.

category_one_liner: Devin is an AI‑powered research and media assistant that helps users generate, summarize, and organize content.
gating_reason: API access requires an application and approval process (wait‑list or enterprise agreement).
api_surface: RESTful JSON endpoints for content generation, summarization, citation extraction, and knowledge‑base queries.
mcp_evidence: The developer docs (docs.devin.ai) reference integration with the Marketplace Connect Platform and display the MCP badge.
main_blocker: Public API is not openly available; access is restricted to approved partners.

category_one_liner: Provides a REST API to retrieve YouTube video transcripts in various formats.
gating_reason: Requires an API key obtained after signing up for a paid plan; free tier may have strict rate limits.
api_surface: REST endpoints for fetching transcripts (JSON, SRT, VTT) and language detection.
mcp_evidence: No public documentation or product pages reference a dedicated Media Content Platform; the service is presented as a simple transcript API.
